text:
morgan: quick alert - short-embed requests (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 started returning intermittent 503s ~02:10 UTC. p99 errors up ~3%. Suspect yesterday's quant kernel. Preparing a revert image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Need fast approvals to deploy in the maintenance window.

liam: customer impact? blocked or degraded?

morgan: degraded for a small subset (~3% traffic). A few support tickets. No schema/db changes.

sara: will deploy require cache changes?

morgan: recommend draining prefix cache after deploy; no migrations.

morgan: deploy command proposed: `/deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:3m --reason "short-embed 503 regression"`

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6432109876 created by morgan. Approvals required: eng-leads (liam,sara) + ops-oncall (dave-ops). Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke: WARNING (503 observed).

dave-ops: oncall ACK. I can approve for ops if we do 5% canary 3m and I monitor traces.

liam: approve for eng if ops watches. /approve 6432109876

sara: approve for QA/docs. I'll draft support blurb. /approve 6432109876

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: liam, sara, dave-ops. Starting canary 5% for embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Canary window 180s. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6432109876

morgan: running drain then `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Canary in progress. Initial metrics: new pods errors 0, latency stable.

dave-ops: canary green. Recommend ramp to 25% for 4m then full if stable. I'm watching.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% started (240s).

deploy-bot: 25% complete; metrics healthy (errors <0.1%, p95 +2ms). Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS.

morgan: drained prefix cache and warmed. No regressions in 10m post-deploy.

liam: thanks. Add release note: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1; canary ramp and prefix cache drain performed."

sara: support blurb filed.

morgan: will follow up with RCA on quant kernel. Closing thread when notes posted. :white_check_mark:
